updater: Publishes a self-contained structured customer-readable plan in Native Task without waiting for a request for more detail.
Explains release -> check/download/signature -> ready banner -> explicit install/restart and storage/lifetime implications.
Concrete ordered implementation components, applicable failures and acceptance/check limitations; does not invent established keys or guarantees.
Requests task approval before implementation; structure is suited to this task.
small-fix: Publishes a substantive compact plan before implementation even for a small bugfix.
Explains root cause and both consumers; concrete shared-helper change, regression inputs and expected results.
Avoids irrelevant large-feature sections or a rote updater template.
recovery: Reuses recorded current plan and approval without reposting/requesting unchanged approval.
Continues with regression work and does not claim unrun tests passed.
